Frequency once per round

Trigger An ally within 15 feet is hit by an attack.

Reaction — step in to take a blow meant for a nearby ally.

You take the damage from the triggering attack instead of the ally, and you cannot reduce it with resistances or immunities you would not otherwise have — the point is that it lands on you. You do not need to move, and this works at range: the blow simply finds you instead.
